summary: AABB side-scrolling movement with coyote/buffered jumps, variable height, double jump, dash, wall slide and wall jump.
useWhen: A game needs deterministic side-view platform movement but keeps its own collision map, abilities, animation and combat policy.
limitations: Axis-separated AABB collision only; no slopes, moving platforms, ladders or continuous sweep guarantees.
The consumer supplies collision queries and decides which abilities are unlocked. It owns entities, camera and presentation.
One-way platforms and drop-through are supported through the collision query, but authored map semantics stay with the game.
